FIELDS.NAME: Solid Foundations Masonry Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Solid Foundations Masonry Services, we specialize in high-quality concrete and masonry solutions for both residential and commercial projects. Our operations encompass a range of services including foundation pouring, brick and block work, stone masonry, and decorative concrete installations. We pride ourselves on using only the finest materials and employing skilled, licensed contractors committed to maintaining a strong safety record. Each project is handled with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring compliance with local building codes and regulations. We continuously conduct safety audits and provide regular training for our workforce, positioning us as a responsible contractor that prioritizes safety and quality in every job we undertake.

Our concrete and masonry services include working on various construction sites where we prioritize compliance with safety regulations, but we have faced incidents relating to OSHA standards in the past three years.
